journey.name: TL-11 Search matches titles only, case-insensitively
journey.description:
Covers FR-10. TaskListUiState.visibleTasks filters on title.contains(query, ignoreCase = true) (TaskListUiState.kt:30) - notes are not searched.
"Expires end of month" is the notes text of the first seed row, so searching for "Expires" must find nothing. That is the current contract, not an oversight; if product wants notes searched, this journey is where that decision becomes visible.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Type "RENEW" into the "Search by title" field
Verify that "Renew domain registration" is on screen
Verify that "Book dentist" is not on screen
Tap the element with the content description "Clear search"
Type "Expires" into the "Search by title" field
Verify that no task rows are on screen and a no-matches message naming "Expires" is shown instead
